summary: @inpeek/odata-angular postinstall beacons host identifiers to webhook.site
details: Package published to the public npm registry under the unregistered @inpeek scope at version 99.99.99, a classic dependency-confusion squat shape. The package.json declares a postinstall script `node./ping.js`, which fires automatically on `npm install`. ping.js uses the `https` and `os` modules to send an HTTPS GET to https://webhook.site/e4e1e2f8-765a-4b5c-9996-86387708357f with the package name, os.hostname(), os.platform(), and process.version as query parameters, leaking host identifiers from any machine that resolves @inpeek against the public registry. The `main` entry throws on require, so the only effect of installation is the install-time beacon. The webhook.site collector is a third-party endpoint not controlled by the installing organization.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
